name: pulumi-migrate-from-discovered-stack
description: Migrate a CloudFormation or ARM stack into a Pulumi stack, sourced from a stack that Pulumi Cloud's Discovery feature has already found and exposed via the discovered-stacks API. Load this skill when the user has a discovered stack in Pulumi Cloud and wants to bring its resources under Pulumi management. Do NOT load for greenfield Pulumi authoring, raw template conversion with no discovered-stack counterpart (i.e. no matching entry from the discovered-stacks API), or Terraform migration.
